import os
from hamana.oracle import OracleConfig, OracleConnector

# Build standalone configuration object
config = OracleConfig(
    user="system",
    password=os.environ.get("ORACLE_PASSWORD"),
    host="localhost",
    service_name="XEPDB1"
)

# Construct connector from configuration object
connector = OracleConnector(config)

# Execute query
result = connector.execute("SELECT sysdate FROM dual")
print(result)
